all_towing_products.title: Australia Wide Camper Room Walls
all_towing_products.body_html:
The premium Australia Wide Camper Room Walls are completely versatile, offering protection from the elements, and adds a touch of privacy for a more comfortable camping experience.

These walls include interchangeable zip-out arches with triple layered windows and doors - Mesh for ventilation, canvas for privacy and a detachable clear plastic layer for rain and wind. If the weather turns bad, you can stay protected while still enjoying the view. On sunny days, simply roll up all layers to fully open the annexe and embrace the outdoors.

Gas BBQ/Kitchen Compliant Annexes are now available. These are customised to include permanent vents on the Draught Skirt and Annexe End Walls. Please contact us for more information.

Features:
  • Canvas top, to allow the annexe to breathe, and a vinyl base for easy cleaning
  • Triple layered windows and doors
  • Mesh for ventilation, canvas for privacy and a detachable clear plastic layer for rain and wind
  • Single window on long side
  • Door/window on each end wall
  • Suitable for use with our Camper Bag Awning
  • Includes Draught Skirt
Includes:
  • Black Draught Skirt
  • Storage Bags
  • Black Poles
  • Ladder Straps
  • Screw In Pegs

Please note, all poles included are black. Does not include Anti-Flap Kit or Curved Roof Rafters.

all_towing_products.title: Awning Safety Strap Kit
all_towing_products.body_html:
This Awning Safety Strap Kit offers added security and assurance that your awning will not lose tension and keep your barrel in place during windy conditions. Made from high quality materials, the awning is secured using the rope attached to the strap. This kit includes 2 safety straps.

Note that brackets and pegs are not included in this kit. A bracket above your current awning sail track is required, as well as a peg to secure it to the ground.

all_towing_products.title: Camper Trailer Cover
all_towing_products.body_html:
Our range of Aussie Traveller Premium Camper Trailer Covers have been designed and manufactured to protect your caravan from the harsh Australian elements. Available in a selection of sizes, all with a waterproof breathable side panel, reinforced skirt and easy-to-fit design. Our range of covers will be sure to keep your camper trailer in pristine condition in the off season - at Aussie Traveller, we have you covered.

Features:
  • Grey colour cover
  • Storage bag and tie down rope included
  • Available in sizes from 10-16ft
  • Made from polyester with PU coating
  • UV 50+ rated roof
  • Water resistant breathable side panels
  • 2 air vents on each side to allow moisture to escape and prevent mildew
  • Lightweight & easily adjustable with elasticised corners to fit and further protect
  • Adjustable front and rear tension panels provide a custom-like fit
  • Zipper and quick release buckles for easy access to your vehicle
  • Reinforced corner patches resist tears and snags
  • Heavy-duty skirt with dual nylon clips, straps and reinforced tab
  • Reflective panels for added safety at night or while parking
  • 3 year warranty

all_towing_products.title: Camper Trailer Stone Guard
all_towing_products.body_html:
Defend your camper trailer from road debris and stone chips with our range of Stone Guards. These guards are designed to protect your camper trailer's paintwork from damage while travelling. Conveniently flat packed, the guards are easy to assemble and install to the A-Frame of your camper trailer. Protect your pride and joy with Aussie Traveller's Stone Guards.

We also offer Stone Guards suitable for Pop-Top Caravans and Full Height Caravans.

Features:
  • Suitable for camper trailers
  • Two heavy-duty mud flaps included
  • 320g tough rip-resistant mesh
  • 25mm steel powder-coated tubing
  • Includes step-by-step guide for easy DIY installation

all_towing_products.title: Canvas Stone Guard Bag
all_towing_products.body_html:
The Aussie Traveller Canvas Stone Guard Bag is a must have for any caravan or camper trailer that has a Stone Guard fitted. Made of strong 420gsm blue Ripstop polycotton canvas, with blue heavy-duty PVC lining, this bag is designed to withstand harsh conditions. Equipped with buckle guards for protection against stones and 2 molle strips at the front to easily clip on any essentials.

This storage bag can be mounted onto front or rear of the stone guard, and features a double-top lid with zipper seal. The inner lid also has a convenient Velcro top so that the zipper can be left open for easy access. This is the perfect addition to house any outdoor accessories, from your water hose, wheel chocks and recovery gear to cooking equipment for your pull-out camp kitchen.

Features:
  • 420gsm Ripstop poly-cotton canvas
  • Heavy-duty PVC lining for easy cleaning & keep your gear dry
  • Buckle guards for protection against stones
  • 2 molle strips on the front to on clip any accessories
  • Zipper sealed double-lid
  • Inner Velcro lid can be left unzipped for easy access
  • Dimensions (L x W x H): 400 x 150 x 510mm

all_towing_products.title: Caravan Awning Rope Clip Kit
all_towing_products.body_html:
The Aussie Traveller Caravan Awning Rope Clip Kit is a full package designed to easily tie-down a roll-out style awning in windy conditions. Featuring durable stainless steel clips, along with screw-in pegs and guy ropes, this kit provides quick and reliable added stability when the weather turns rough.

The included 17mm hex adaptor drill socket means you can tie down your awning instantly using just a hand drill with the screw in pegs. No hammering in regular tent pegs into hard dirt! 

With a universal fit to suit most rollout awnings, this Caravan Awning Rope Clip Kit can be used in conjunction with the Aussie Traveller Anti-Flap Kit.

Features:
  • Stainless steel awning rope clips
  • Fits most roll-out awnings
  • Easy assembly and installation
  • Secure your awning in windy weather
  • Full kit to secure your awning
  • Peg clips included for attaching ropes to pegs securely
  • Use with or without Aussie Traveller Anti-Flap Kits installed
Includes:
  • 2 x Awning Rope Clips
  • 2 x Guy Ropes
  • 2 x 300mm Screw In Pegs
  • 2 x Peg Clips
  • 1 x 17mm Hex Adaptor Drill Socket

all_towing_products.title: D-Shackle 10mm
all_towing_products.body_html:
Whether for work or adventure, Aussie Traveller D-Shackles provide unmatched strength and reliability, with a range of sizes to handle any load with confidence.

These D-shackles are designed to meet the rigorous standards of AS2741-20002, ensuring reliability and safety for heavy-duty applications. Each shackle is clearly marked with a batch number engraved on the body, providing traceability and quality assurance.

Available in four sizes: 8mm, 10mm, 11mm, and 13mm, with load limits ranging from 750kg to 2000kg.

Features:
  • 10mm D-Shackle rated 1000kg load limit
  • Complies with AS2741-20002
  • Batch number engraved on the shackle
